types.string: Arrow utf8 / Parquet BYTE_ARRAY annotated STRING

common_rules.metadata: Parquet key/value metadata bv.contract=run-bundle/1.0.0 and bv.section=<section name>
common_rules.nullability: Exact REQUIRED/OPTIONAL repetition matches nullable; nullable column must exist even if entirely null.
common_rules.timestamp: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.nnnnnnnnnZ, year 1970..9999, valid Gregorian date, no leap seconds.

fields.name: fact_id
fields.meaning: Stable section-scoped immutable fact ID.

fields.name: known_at_utc
fields.meaning: Exact runner knowledge instant; gates containing-minute replay.

fields.name: sequence_num
fields.meaning: Nonnegative integer, unique per section and reveal minute.

fields.name: execution_id
fields.meaning: Unique fill ID; equals fact_id.

fields.name: position_id
fields.meaning: Logical position ID, required; reversal opens a new ID.

fields.name: timestamp_utc
fields.meaning: Fill occurrence instant, no later than known_at_utc.

fields.name: side
fields.meaning: BUY or SELL execution side.

fields.name: action
fields.meaning: ENTRY, SCALE_IN, SCALE_OUT, or EXIT; ENTRY begins and EXIT terminates position.

fields.name: quantity
fields.meaning: Positive per-fill quantity in manifest quantity_unit.

fields.name: price
fields.meaning: Finite execution price in instrument price_unit; zero/negative allowed.

fields.name: realized_gross_pnl
fields.meaning: Incremental realized amount in account_currency; null means not supplied.

fields.name: commission
fields.meaning: Account-currency debit positive, rebate negative; null unknown, zero explicitly none.

fields.name: other_costs
fields.meaning: Incremental other account-currency debits or credits; null unknown.

fields.name: strategy_id
fields.meaning: Emitted strategy attribution; null unassigned and not matched by a strategy filter.

fields.name: setup_id
fields.meaning: Opaque run-scoped setup grouping token, not a catalogue reference.

fields.name: session_id
fields.meaning: Optional emitted session association.

fields.name: metadata_json
fields.meaning: Strict JSON object containing information already known at known_at_utc.

fields.name: open_quantity
fields.meaning: Nonnegative current position size; CLOSE requires zero.

fields.name: total_entry_quantity
fields.meaning: Producer-supplied cumulative entry quantity so far.

fields.name: total_exit_quantity
fields.meaning: Producer-supplied cumulative exit quantity so far.

fields.name: realized_net_pnl
fields.meaning: Producer-supplied realized net amount known so far.

fields.name: net_pnl
fields.meaning: Final producer-supplied net outcome; null except CLOSE.

fields.name: exit_time_utc
fields.meaning: Final exit occurrence; null except CLOSE.

fields.name: duration_seconds
fields.meaning: Producer-supplied holding seconds; null except CLOSE.
